title: Fix Broken Tasks
description: Repair task import reliability for manually edited task JSON files that currently show as load/import errors in the Tasks UI. Prioritize tolerant parsing (without silently corrupting data), clear repair diagnostics, and verification for the reported IDs (TSK-0218/0220/0221/0222/0224/0251/0252).

comments.author: TheMasonX
comments.body: 218 251 252 224 222 221 220 are some tasks seen with issues

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented tolerant task-load parsing for manual edits (JSON comments and trailing commas) and added load-time normalization for missing/null optional collections/fields so task summaries no longer crash with import-like errors. Added regression test TasksApi_TaskFileWithTrailingCommaAndComment_LoadsWithoutImportError; existing malformed JSON fallback tests still pass.
